text:
deploybot: attempted percent bump -> 5% -> 10% at 10:45 UTC as scheduled. detected anomalous schema mismatch for replies renderer in ap-south.
anya: mismatch how severe? sample size?
lucas: renderer errors ~0.6% of ap-south requests, p99 latency +120ms, some JSON parse errors surfaced. sample window 2.5m.
priya: recommend HOLD for ap-south and pin region to last-stable, don't touch other regions. change window 10:30-11:15 UTC.
jess: agree. also add a deploy tag so automation doesn't retry bump for that region.
ops-bot: suggested hold command: ```
releasectl hold --deployment staged --region ap-south --reason "format-drift-json-parse"
releasectl tag --deployment staged --region ap-south --tag no-auto-bump
```
releasebot: release notes updated: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-04-12#format-drift. attaching quick-dash: https://telemetry.redwood/rollouts/1945678901
deploybot: hold command executed for ap-south. region pinned to v2026.03.29. auto-bump blocked by tag `no-auto-bump`.
anya: vote: pause+pin ap-south? 3m to object.
lucas: no objection.
priya: no objection, will trace request bodies and check router changes.
jess: no objection.
releasebot: summary: ap-south held & pinned to v2026.03.29; auto-bump prevented; global staged rollout remains at 10% (other regions). incident INC-2026-045 opened.
ops-bot: reminder: if we decide to unpin after fixes run: ```
releasectl unpin --deployment staged --region ap-south --confirm
releasectl resume --deployment staged --region ap-south
```
priya: running quick diff between tokenizers and JSON serializer versions across nodes. posting logs in ~6m.
lucas: also enabling extra validation on renderer to reject malformed proto earlier, to reduce parse fallback cost.
anya: small note for release docs: add a "held region" section with incident link.
jess: pinging oncall infra for potential hotfix deploy if root cause is infra config.
ops-bot: automation will not proceed with region-level percent changes while `no-auto-bump` tag present. escalation ping sent to oncall-sre.
deploybot: holding further percent increases for ap-south and failing safe for 10m. will auto-notify when issue clears or if rollback requested.
lucas: triage started. will reconvene here with canary-eval results or rollback proposal.
priya: if we see regression widening to >1.5% or other regions report similar patterns, propose global rollback using: ```
releasectl rollback --deployment staged --to v2026.03.29 --confirm --reason "format-drift-widening"
```
anya: thanks team. keep thread tight — post only essential updates and links to traces.
releasebot: action items recorded in INC-2026-045. timeline: triage window 30m.
ops-bot: pin/unpin logs and operator who ran commands appended to incident.
deploybot: standing by.
